judgment_text:
Prayer in Application No. 161 of 2026

Prayer in Application No. 159 of 2026

COMMON ORDER

These applications have been filed by the applicants/plaintiffs to permit the applicants to file reply statement to the written statement filed by the respondents 1, 3 and 4/Defendants 1, 3 and 4

2. According to the applicants, they are the plaintiffs in the main suit and the respondents 1, 3 and 4/Defendants 1, 3 and 4 have filed written statements by introducing a new plea, therefore, necessity has arisen for the applicants to file reply statement for the written statements filed by the respondents 1, 3 and 4/Defendants 1, 3 and 4, therefore, filed these applications.

3. The learned counsel appearing for the respondents has not filed any counter affidavits.

4. Considering the reasons stated in the affidavits filed in support of the applications and taking note of the fact that already the respondents 1, 3 and 4/Defendants 1, 3 and 4 have filed their written statements by introducing a new plea, it is appropriate to allow the present applications. The reply statement filed by the applicants/plaintiffs to the written statements filed by the respondents 1, 3 and 4/Defendants 1, 3 and 4 are received and taken on file.

Accordingly, these applications are allowed. Post the matter for “framing issues” on 24-2-2026.
